lines.zh: 我抱着胳膊走过麦田，脚步像在算账。
lines.en: I cross the wheat field hugging my arms, counting coins.

lines.zh: 我走得像去赶集，其实在找你。
lines.en: I walk as if to market, but I am hunting you.

lines.zh: 草鞋磨着村道，白眼睛盯着前方。
lines.en: My straw shoes rasp the road, white eyes fixed ahead.

lines.zh: 我经过自家门口，没有推门。
lines.en: I pass my own door and do not push it.

lines.zh: 我走路时有人在里面数数。
lines.en: Someone inside me counts my steps as I walk.

lines.zh: 我绕过钟楼，铜声让我牙根发酸。
lines.en: I skirt the bell tower; bronze hum aches my teeth.

lines.zh: 我一步步挪向铁傀儡，又改道。
lines.en: I shuffle toward the iron golem, then change course.

lines.zh: 我的步子不快，可从不偏。
lines.en: My pace is slow, but it never wanders.

lines.zh: 我踩过胡萝卜地，记下每垄位置。
lines.en: I tread the carrot rows and memorize each one.

lines.zh: 你走多快，我就走多快。
lines.en: However fast you walk, I match it.

lines.zh: 我在村道上留下两行深浅不一的脚印。
lines.en: I leave two trails of uneven prints on the road.

lines.zh: 白眼睛看路，另一双眼睛看你。
lines.en: One white pair watches the road, one watches you.

lines.zh: 我站着，喉咙里咕噜着两种声音。
lines.en: I stand still, two voices grumbling in my throat.

lines.zh: 我摸着口袋，里面只剩一枚绿宝石。
lines.en: I feel my pocket; one emerald is left.

lines.zh: 屋顶的烟直着升，我看了很久。
lines.en: The chimney smoke rises straight; I watch it long.

lines.zh: 火光在我的白眼球里烧，不熄。
lines.en: Firelight burns in my white eyes and will not die.

lines.zh: 我把手举到脸前，像要作揖。
lines.en: I raise my hands before my face as if to bow.

lines.zh: 村里谁家生孩子，我都听得见。
lines.en: I can hear which house has a newborn.

lines.zh: 有人在里面替我呼吸，节奏很慢。
lines.en: Someone breathes for me inside, very slowly.

lines.zh: 我数着村民的呼吸声打发时间。
lines.en: I pass the time counting villagers' breathing.

lines.zh: 鸡在旁边刨土，我不敢动。
lines.en: A chicken scratches nearby; I dare not move.

lines.zh: 我把绿宝石攥紧，直到掌心发烫。
lines.en: I squeeze the emerald until my palm burns.

lines.zh: 我抬头，白眼睛正对着你的脸。
lines.en: I lift my head; white eyes meet your face.

lines.zh: 你盯我，我也盯你，谁也不让。
lines.en: You stare, I stare, neither yields.

lines.zh: 我认出你了，那件外套我修过。
lines.en: I know you; I once mended that coat.

lines.zh: 我的瞳孔里有两道白，一道不是我。
lines.en: Two whites in my pupils, one is not mine.

lines.zh: 我歪头，像在听你还没说的话。
lines.en: I tilt my head, listening to what you have not said.

lines.zh: 你手里没有绿宝石，我很失望。
lines.en: No emerald in your hand; how disappointing.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，先出声的是一声咕噜。
lines.en: I open my mouth, and a grunt comes first.

lines.zh: 我用你的名字试了试声音，很难听。
lines.en: I test my voice on your name; it sounds wrong.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的后颈，那里跳得很快。
lines.en: I stare at your neck, where the pulse races.

lines.zh: 我看了你一眼，就不再是村民了。
lines.en: One look at you, and I am no longer a villager.

lines.zh: 剑砍进肩膀，我只是低了低头。
lines.en: The sword bites my shoulder; I only lower my head.

lines.zh: 血是红的，声音却不是我的。
lines.en: The blood is red, but the scream is not mine.

lines.zh: 疼的时候，它在里面笑。
lines.en: When it hurts, it laughs inside.

lines.zh: 我护得住皮，护不住这具身体。
lines.en: I can guard my hide, not this body.

lines.zh: 你的箭弹在护甲上，叮一声。
lines.en: Your arrow bounces off my armor with a ping.

lines.zh: 伤口合得比该有的快。
lines.en: The wound closes faster than it should.

lines.zh: 我一喊，两个声音一起出来。
lines.en: I cry out and two voices come together.

lines.zh: 别打头，那里还有人在。
lines.en: Not the head; someone is still in there.

lines.zh: 我退了，可它没退。
lines.en: I recoil, but it does not.

lines.zh: 这点疼，比清醒轻多了。
lines.en: This pain is lighter than being awake.

lines.zh: 你手里有绿宝石？我闻得到。
lines.en: An emerald in your hand? I can smell it.

lines.zh: 面包的味道让我停了一瞬。
lines.en: The smell of bread stops me for a moment.

lines.zh: 我想跟你换，可我的手不听话。
lines.en: I want to trade, but my hands will not obey.

lines.zh: 那堆胡萝卜本该归我。
lines.en: That pile of carrots should be mine.

lines.zh: 我伸手去接，指尖却在抖。
lines.en: I reach to take it, and my fingertips shake.

lines.zh: 我听见一个声音说：别换。
lines.en: A voice inside says: do not trade.

lines.zh: 你抬高价，我居然点了头。
lines.en: You raise the price, and I actually nod.

lines.zh: 我吞着口水，喉咙发出咕噜声。
lines.en: I swallow hard and my throat grunts.

lines.zh: 拿着它，别让我抢。
lines.en: Hold it tight, before I snatch it.

lines.zh: 绿宝石在闪，我的白眼睛更亮。
lines.en: The emerald glints and my white eyes shine brighter.

lines.zh: 撞到我，你会被那双白眼睛记住。
lines.en: Bump into me and those white eyes remember you.

lines.zh: 我的胳膊像两截硬木，别硬推。
lines.en: My arms are two lengths of hard wood; do not push.

lines.zh: 你退开，我就当没这回事。
lines.en: Step back and I will pretend it never happened.

lines.zh: 撞上来的村民，后来都不见了。
lines.en: Villagers who bumped into me were never seen again.

lines.zh: 我肩膀一沉，把你顶回去。
lines.en: I drop my shoulder and shove you back.

lines.zh: 我很慢，可撞起来很实在。
lines.en: I am slow, but my weight is real.

lines.zh: 别贴太近，我做不了自己的主。
lines.en: Do not press close; I am not my own master.

lines.zh: 我转身撞开门，只撞开一半。
lines.en: I turn and hit the door, opening only half.

lines.zh: 你碰到我时，我听见两声咳。
lines.en: When you touch me, I hear two coughs.

lines.zh: 护甲挡下你的推挤，纹丝不动。
lines.en: My hide stops your shoving without a shift.

lines.zh: 我本有个家，在教堂后面。
lines.en: I had a home once, behind the church.

lines.zh: 我记得她的围裙是蓝色的。
lines.en: I remember her apron was blue.

lines.zh: 别再跟着我，她会看见。
lines.en: Stop following me; she will see.

lines.zh: 这门亲事，我配不上了。
lines.en: That marriage is beyond me now.

lines.zh: 我把婚约留在门缝里，没敢拿。
lines.en: I left the promise in the door gap.

lines.zh: 两个人睡一张床，现在只有一个。
lines.en: Two once shared a bed; now only one.

lines.zh: 我身上这件袍子是别人替我穿的。
lines.en: Someone else dressed me in this robe.

lines.zh: 别把我推给她，我这张脸不对。
lines.en: Do not push me toward her; this face is wrong.

lines.zh: 她叫我名字时，我差点应了。
lines.en: When she called my name, I almost answered.

lines.zh: 夜里有人替我回家，那不是我。
lines.en: Someone goes home for me at night; it is not me.

lines.zh: 我捡起地上的面包，慢慢啃。
lines.en: I pick up the bread and chew it slowly.

lines.zh: 绿宝石落地，我弯腰比谁都快。
lines.en: An emerald drops; I stoop faster than anyone.

lines.zh: 我捡起铁镐，又放下了。
lines.en: I pick up the iron pick and put it down.

lines.zh: 掉落的东西，我一件件捡回家。
lines.en: I gather every dropped thing and carry it home.

lines.zh: 我拾起一顶草帽，扣在头上。
lines.en: I pick up a straw hat and set it on my head.

lines.zh: 弯腰的时候，有人在我耳边笑。
lines.en: As I bend, someone laughs at my ear.

lines.zh: 我捡起石块，掂了掂，扔了。
lines.en: I pick up a stone, weigh it, and throw it.

lines.zh: 那枚绿宝石，我攥了一路。
lines.en: That emerald stayed clenched in my fist all the way.

lines.zh: 我不捡武器，捡了会伤人。
lines.en: I do not pick up weapons; it would end badly.

lines.zh: 你丢的东西，我先替你拿着。
lines.en: Whatever you drop, I will hold it first.

lines.zh: 你在田那头，我的白眼睛先亮了。
lines.en: You are across the field; my white eyes brighten first.

lines.zh: 我停下手里的活，转向你。
lines.en: I stop my work and turn to you.

lines.zh: 村里的钟还没响，我先动了。
lines.en: The village bell has not rung; I move first.

lines.zh: 我认出了你的脚步，比狗还准。
lines.en: I know your footsteps better than any dog.

lines.zh: 有东西借我的眼睛看中了你。
lines.en: Something borrowed my eyes and chose you.

lines.zh: 我从麦垛后走出来，不再藏。
lines.en: I step out from the haystack and stop hiding.

lines.zh: 你踩坏的那垄麦子，我记着。
lines.en: I remember the wheat row you trampled.

lines.zh: 我举起手，像在招呼，其实在指。
lines.en: I raise a hand as if greeting, and I point.

lines.zh: 距离够了，我的步子就变重。
lines.en: Close enough now; my steps grow heavy.

lines.zh: 咕噜声从我喉咙里滚出来。
lines.en: A grunt rolls up out of my throat.

lines.zh: 我先把门关上，再朝你走。
lines.en: I shut the door first, then come for you.

lines.zh: 你逃向井边，我早在那儿等过。
lines.en: You run for the well; I have waited there already.

lines.zh: 是你，还是那个声音在挑？
lines.en: Is it you, or the voice doing the choosing?

lines.zh: 这村里活人不少，我只挑你。
lines.en: Many living here, and I choose only you.

lines.zh: 钟响了，可我已经在你门口。
lines.en: The bell rang, but I am already at your door.

lines.zh: 我一路小跑，胳膊还没放下。
lines.en: I trot after you, arms still raised.

lines.zh: 你翻过篱笆，我的手卡在缝里。
lines.en: You climb the fence; my hand jams in the gap.

lines.zh: 我绕过水井，不踩湿砖。
lines.en: I go around the well, avoiding wet bricks.

lines.zh: 你的心跳在墙后面，很响。
lines.en: Your heartbeat is loud behind that wall.

lines.zh: 我敲门，敲得很有礼貌。
lines.en: I knock on the door, quite politely.

lines.zh: 你躲进谷仓，我就在门口站住。
lines.en: You hide in the barn; I stop at the door.

lines.zh: 我追得慢，但你得一直跑。
lines.en: I chase slowly, but you must keep running.

lines.zh: 别往铁傀儡那边跑，我要绕路。
lines.en: Do not run toward the iron golem; I must detour.

lines.zh: 白眼睛在暗处更亮。
lines.en: My white eyes burn brighter in the dark.

lines.zh: 我推开挡路的羊，没有停。
lines.en: I shove a sheep aside without stopping.

lines.zh: 你数着拐角，我数着你的呼吸。
lines.en: You count the corners; I count your breaths.

lines.zh: 这个村子我熟，每条巷子都熟。
lines.en: I know this village, every alley of it.

lines.zh: 我踩碎一块陶瓦，声音追着你。
lines.en: I crush a clay tile; the sound follows you.

lines.zh: 那道声音一直催我，别停。
lines.en: That voice keeps urging me not to stop.

lines.zh: 我在你身后三步，一直没改。
lines.en: I stay three steps behind and never change.

lines.zh: 你跑进巷子，我抄近道。
lines.en: You ran into the alley. I take the short way.

lines.zh: 门闩很旧，我推得开。
lines.en: The latch is old. I can push it open.

lines.zh: 我停下，是因为你停下了。
lines.en: I stopped because you stopped.

lines.zh: 我一拳砸在你胸口，很沉。
lines.en: I drive a fist into your chest, heavy.

lines.zh: 我的力气不该这么大。
lines.en: This strength should not be mine.

lines.zh: 你退了半步，我跟着半步。
lines.en: You step back half; I follow half.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的领子，往门框上撞。
lines.en: I grab your collar and slam you into the frame.

lines.zh: 打你的时候，我的手在发抖。
lines.en: While I strike you, my hands are shaking.

lines.zh: 我用肘撞你的护肩，咔一声。
lines.en: I drive an elbow into your shoulder guard; it cracks.

lines.zh: 我用的是锄头的手势。
lines.en: I swing with a hoe's old habit.

lines.zh: 铁味在嘴里，我说不清是谁的。
lines.en: Iron is in my mouth; I cannot say whose.

lines.zh: 别让我抓住你的手腕。
lines.en: Do not let me catch your wrist.

lines.zh: 我打人很慢，可从不打空。
lines.en: My blows are slow, but they never miss.

lines.zh: 这一下是它借我的手打的。
lines.en: That blow was struck by it, through my hand.

lines.zh: 你流血的声响，让它很兴奋。
lines.en: The sound of your blood excites it.

lines.zh: 我退开时，指甲还在你衣服上。
lines.en: I pull back, nails still in your clothes.

lines.zh: 跑吧，我打完会站在原地理衣领。
lines.en: Run; afterward I stand here straightening my collar.

lines.zh: 我用手背抽你的脸，很响。
lines.en: I backhand your face, and it rings.

lines.zh: 你被按在草垛上，动弹不得。
lines.en: You are pinned against the hay, unable to move.

lines.zh: 门开了，屋里的村民不见了。
lines.en: The door opens; the villager inside is gone.

lines.zh: 我从床边的暗处站起来。
lines.en: I rise from the dark beside the bed.

lines.zh: 村子还是那个村子，我不是了。
lines.en: The village is the same; I am not.

lines.zh: 你听见的咕噜声，是打招呼。
lines.en: That grunt you heard was a greeting.

lines.zh: 天亮前，村口多了一个影子。
lines.en: Before dawn, one more shadow at the gate.

lines.zh: 白眼睛先在窗纸上亮起来。
lines.en: White eyes glow on the window paper first.

lines.zh: 我穿着原来的衣服，扣子扣错了。
lines.en: I wear my old clothes, buttons misaligned.

lines.zh: 有人在我脑子里数到三。
lines.en: Someone counts to three inside my head.

lines.zh: 夜里别敲村民的门。
lines.en: Do not knock on a villager's door at night.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，先是一声很轻的咕噜。
lines.en: I open my mouth; a soft grunt comes out first.

lines.zh: 这排房子，我一家一家走过。
lines.en: I walked this row of houses, door by door.

lines.zh: 你要找的村民，就在这儿。
lines.en: The villager you seek is right here.

lines.zh: 火一上身，附身的东西就往里缩。
lines.en: Fire touches me and the thing inside shrinks back.

lines.zh: 落地时骨头响，我听见它在数。
lines.en: My bones crack on landing; I hear it counting.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，另一个声音在呛。
lines.en: Water fills my throat and another voice chokes.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，白眼睛没闭。
lines.en: The blast throws me down; my white eyes stay open.

lines.zh: 箭插在胸口，我慢慢拔出来。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my chest; I pull it out slowly.

lines.zh: 药水在我身上起了反作用。
lines.en: The potion works backward on me.

lines.zh: 我饿，可我不想吃。
lines.en: I am hungry, but I do not want to eat.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，白眼睛亮得刺眼。
lines.en: Lightning falls, and my white eyes blaze.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，它还在我脑子里说。
lines.en: Falling into the void, it still speaks in my head.
